How PULSE works
Made for ordinary people

You do not need to be a journalist. Watch what is happening, choose your place, and report what you see.

1
WatchSwipe up on Home to move through reports. Tap Like, Comments, Save or Share when useful.
2
Choose your placeTap the place name at the top to choose any Uganda village, town or district.
3
PostTap Post, then Record, Photo or Write. Describe what happened in normal words.
4
Check a reportOpen More story details if you need evidence, source information, related reports or claim tools.

How posting works here
Standalone prototype. PULSE V80 separates what the interface can genuinely do on this device from the network services a production app would need.
▤Save reportThe report is stored in this browser/device and appears in the local PULSE feed.
⌖Nearby eligibilityA saved place can make the report appear in local Nearby filtering. Real distance is only calculated when coordinates exist.
＋Followers labelThe prototype can label intended audience, but it does not remotely deliver a post to follower accounts.
☁Production publishingA real release would need a backend, authentication, media upload, moderation, delivery and push-notification services.

What works in this version
Standalone PULSE. This page separates features available locally in the browser from services that need a real backend or network infrastructure.
My local stats
Device-only counts. These numbers come from data actually saved by this standalone PULSE file. They are not public reach, audience size, impressions, or remote engagement.
Share saved contact
The selected contact is added as text to this local conversation. No message is sent to that contact.
Add to local chat
Only actions that genuinely store something locally are shown here. Photo/file upload is not presented as remote delivery in this standalone version.

Restore PULSE backup
No backup selectedChoose a PULSE V93 backup file first.
Safer option. Existing PULSE keys and reports stay in place. The backup fills missing local data and missing reports.
Replace mode clears current PULSE local data and known PULSE IndexedDB stores before restoring this backup. Other websites/apps are not touched.
Backup & restore
No cloud is involved. Backups are JSON files created on this device. Data-only backups exclude media. Media backups can be much larger and include report media, evidence attachments, saved-draft media and local chat voice notes when those files are available.

Trust & verification
No remote verification service is connected. In This version, PULSE does not claim that a story or source has been independently verified. Evidence, confirmations and reporter updates remain separate signals.
TRUST OVERVIEW No story selected Open a report and tap its status to inspect that specific story.

●Story statusPULSE uses honest labels such as Citizen Report, Reporter says resolved, and Demo story. PULSE does not silently turn local evidence into verification.
◉Source statusA source profile can show what is loaded on this device, but there is no independent source-verification service connected in this standalone app.
▣EvidencePhotos, videos, notes, location observations and source references can be stored locally. They do not automatically prove or verify a report.
✓Confirm / disputeYour reaction is saved locally. PULSE does not invent a public community total or claim other people confirmed the story.

Profile photo

Use a real photo for your PULSE profile. You decide whether Android opens the phone camera or your photo library.

Privacy: taking a profile picture this way does not give PULSE continuous camera access. The separate Camera Studio uses browser camera/microphone permission only when you explicitly open it. Profile photos remain on this device until a real account backend is connected.
